abstract: In this paper, we improve on existing language resources for the low-resource Filipino language in two ways. First, we outline the construction of the TLUnified dataset, a large-scale pretraining corpus that serves as an improvement over smaller existing pretraining datasets for the language in terms of scale and topic variety. Second, we pretrain new Transformer language models following the RoBERTa pretraining technique to supplant existing models trained with small corpora. Our new RoBERTa models show significant improvements over existing Filipino models in three benchmark datasets with an average gain of 4.47% test accuracy across the three classification tasks of varying difficulty.

bibliographic.title: Improving Large-scale Language Models and Resources for Filipino

content.problem: Filipino, a low-resource language, lacks pretraining corpora and pretrained models that are large and topically varied enough to build robust NLP systems.
content.proposed_solution: The authors construct TLUnified, a large and topically varied Filipino pretraining corpus assembled from multiple sources with filtering and deduplication, and use it to pretrain RoBERTa Base and Large models that are finetuned on three Filipino classification benchmarks.
content.algorithm_or_model: RoBERTa (Base and Large) pretrained on TLUnified
dataset_testbed: TLUnified (new Filipino pretraining corpus built from OSCAR, NewsPH, and multiple bilingual bitexts)

content.claim: Pretraining RoBERTa on TLUnified yields substantial test accuracy gains of roughly four to five points over prior Filipino pretrained transformers across three classification benchmarks.
author_stated_limitations: TLUnified may still be too small to fully exploit the capacity of a Large-variant transformer, so RoBERTa Large beats Base only marginally and would need more pretraining data for non-marginal gains.

evidence.problem_quote: Unlike High-resource Languages (HRL) such as English, German, and French, Low-resource Languages (LRL) suffer from a lack of benchmark datasets, databases, linguistic tools, and pretrained models that impede the progress of research within those languages.
evidence.proposed_solution_quote: In this paper, we improve on existing language resources for the low-resource Filipino language in two ways. First, we outline the construction of the TLUnified dataset, a large-scale pretraining corpus that serves as an improvement over smaller existing pretraining datasets for the language in terms of scale and topic variety.
evidence.claim_quote: Our new RoBERTa models show significant improvements over existing Filipino models in three benchmark datasets with an average gain of 4.47% test accuracy across the three classification tasks of varying difficulty.
author_stated_limitation_quotes: While the size of TLUnified is much larger than the previous WikiText-TL-39, it may still not be enough to make full use of the capacity of a Large-variant Transformer. We surmise that RoBERTa Large may need to be trained with more data to show significant, non-marginal improvements in performance.
